79. Let f be a function having derivatives of all orders for x > 0 such that f(3) = 2, f'(3) = -1, f"(3) = 6, and
f"(3) = 12. Which of the following is the third-degree Taylor polynomial for f about x = 3 ?
(A) 2 -x + 6x² + 12x3
(B) 2- x+ 3x² + 2x3
(C) 2 - (x - 3) + 6(x - 3)² + 12(x - 3)3
(D) 2 -(x- 3)+ 3(x- 3)² + 4(x- 3)3
(E) 2 - (x - 3) + 3(x - 3)² + 2(x - 3)3
